name: solid-v2-first-pass
description: Binding-aware first Solid 1 to Solid 2 migration slice for applications and libraries

scripts.test: pnpm run test:config && pnpm run test:source && pnpm run test:validate && pnpm run test:validate-fail && pnpm run test:preflight && pnpm run test:runner && pnpm run test:idempotency
scripts.test:config: pnpm dlx codemod@latest jssg test -l json ./scripts/config.ts ./tests/config --strictness strict
scripts.test:source: pnpm dlx codemod@latest jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/source.ts ./tests/source --strictness strict
scripts.test:validate: pnpm dlx codemod@latest jssg test -l tsx ./scripts/validate.ts ./tests/validate --strictness strict
